name: Judging Other People
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to refrain from harsh or hypocritical judgment of others, as seen in Jesus' commands to 'Judge not, that ye be not judged' (Matthew 7:1) and 'Judge not, and ye shall not be judged' (Luke 6:37). True judgment must be righteous and discerning rather than superficial, as Jesus instructs in John 7:24. Furthermore, the warning in Romans 2:1 highlights the danger of condemning others while committing the same sins oneself. Yet, the New Testament also encourages believers to recognize and avoid those who cause division by opposing sound doctrine (Romans 16:17), showing that judgment aligned with biblical truth is necessary for the health of the church.
